meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过知识图谱问答理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解不熟悉的代码库或审查代码逻辑。
copy.tagline_en: Understand codebases through knowledge graph Q&A
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand unfamiliar code or review code logic.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取项目中的知识图谱文件，根据你的问题搜索相关代码节点、函数、类等，并解释它们之间的关系和所在架构层。
howto.when: 当你想了解项目代码的结构、功能或组件间关系时，直接提问即可触发。

say.text: 这个项目中 main.py 里的 run 函数是做什么的？
say.note: Claude 会从知识图谱中查找该函数并解释其作用。

say.text: 用户登录功能涉及哪些文件和模块？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关节点和边，给出依赖关系。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph file, searches for relevant code nodes (files, functions, classes, etc.) based on your question, and explains their relationships and architectural layers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions about the codebase's structure, functionality, or component relationships.

say_en.text: What does the run function in main.py do?
say_en.note: Claude looks up the function in the knowledge graph and explains its purpose.

say_en.text: Which files and modules are involved in user login?
say_en.note: Claude searches for relevant nodes and edges to show dependencies.
